option_checks.evidence: Equal swept volumes preserve gas volume in the described double-piston model, contradicting the asserted volume decrease. Confusing sealed mass with fixed volume produces the author's erroneous liquid equality.
Compressibility changes volume response but does not prevent confined air transmitting pressure and actuating a piston.
At fixed gas pressure F=pS still increases with area. Treating compression as absorbing all area-force effect wrongly deletes this dependence.
